title: Etale extension by zero commutes with base change for module sheaves
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $j:V\to X$ be etale, and form the fibre-product square [def-pc-fibre-product] with $V'=Y\times_XV$, $j':V'\to Y$, and $f':V'\to V$. For a commutative ring $\Lambda$ and a sheaf $M$ of $\Lambda_V$-modules on $V_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the canonical base-change morphism $f^{-1}(j_!M)\to j'_!((f')^{-1}M)$, where inverse image is [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and $j_!$ is etale extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension], is an isomorphism. This is Stacks Project Lemma 59.70.5, Tag 03S6 (lemma-shriek-base-change), in the module-sheaf form.

mathlib_searches.query: inverse image commutes with extension by zero along an etale morphism for sheaves of modules
mathlib_searches.results: No small-etale-site extension-by-zero base-change theorem for module sheaves; only generic inverse-image functor results.

mathlib_searches.query: IsIso (f inverse image map j shriek) etale sheaf modules
mathlib_searches.results: No matching declaration; results concern generic sheaf inverse images and adjunctions.
No extension-by-zero base-change theorem for etale module sheaves in Mathlib.
